items.evidence: Since 2013, PRSUs have been based 50% on three-year average ROA and 50% on three-year average growth in adjusted tangible book value (TBV) goals.
The awards are equally weighted with 50% based on ROA goals and 50% based on adjusted TBV growth goals.
